messages:
ravi: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread 1 — we need a concise action register for GPU capacity + autoscaling. I'll list candidate tasks; please claim and add ETA.

marta: I'll take temporary quota + billing approval. ETA: Fri EOD. Need a short justification string and current pool numbers.

jordan: I'll own scheduler tuning + canary tests. Plan: micro-tune `scheduler.max_pending` and `batch_window_ms` per-route, run canary on `gpu-canary-a`. ETA: Tue COB.

tess: Runbook owner. I'll produce a minimal incident playbook with exact commands and an automated checklist for oncall. ETA: Wed AM.

zhen: I'll take telemetry + smoke harness: emit `gpu.headroom.1m`, `gpu.headroom.5m`, `model.qps.1m`, and add a load-driver that can replay the surge pattern. ETA: Thu EOD.

ravi: Current snapshot for ticket: reserved pools = 56 GPUs, observed 1m rolling peak = 101 GPUs, target headroom = 25% (~14 GPUs), observed headroom ~= 4 GPUs. Cost impact estimate pending.

ravi: Candidate action register:
- QUOTA: temporary soft quota + billing signoff (owner: marta)
- SCHEDULER: per-route tuning + canary + smoke tests (owner: jordan)
- TELEMETRY: 1m/5m headroom metrics + replay harness (owner: zhen)
- RUNBOOK: concise surge playbook + immediate mitigation steps (owner: tess)
- AUTOSCALER: safety-buffer policy (min_free_gpus) + incident trigger on sustained <10% headroom (owner: ravi)

marta: For infra ticket I'll use: "Sustained bursts exceeded reserved capacity by ~80%; requesting temporary soft quota to restore 25% headroom while autoscaler and scheduler fixes are validated." Anyone want to tweak that line?

jordan: Looks good. Tuning notes: I'll try `scheduler.max_pending += 12%` and `batch_window_ms` from 55 -> 30 on latency routes. Also add a quick preemptive scale rule for 95th-percentile spikes. Canary plan: 30m run, measure p95, queue length, and failed schedules; rollback criteria: p95 +15% or failed schedules > baseline + 20.

zhen: Telemetry plan: publish metrics and a dashboard tile, and add an automated smoke harness under `tools/loadgen/gpu-surge-replay`. Will create an alert rule: headroom <10% for 3m -> create incident. ETA Thu EOD.

tess: Runbook will include runnable commands: `rbctl scale --pool=reserved --min=20`, `rbctl scale --pool=burst --max=120`, plus an emergency quota escalation template. PR will include test checklist. ETA Wed AM.

ops-bot: Created INFRA-801 (quota), INFRA-802 (scheduler canary), INFRA-803 (telemetry), INFRA-804 (runbook). Links: https://tracker.internal/INFRA-801..804. Assigned as requested.

marta: Claiming INFRA-801. ETA Fri 18:00 UTC. I'll include ravi's snapshot and ops-bot cost stub. CC billing for approval.

jordan: I'll post the canary config and load script to INFRA-802 and link the smoke test. ETA Tue COB. Note: will include cost delta in report.

zhen: INFRA-803 will include the replay harness and dashboard tile. I'll wire the alert to paging. ETA Thu EOD.

ravi: Autoscaler guardrail: propose `min_free_gpus = max(ceil(reserved*0.20), 10)` and an emergency override flag for oncall with TTL. I'll own the policy change and tests. ETA Mon.

tess: PR opened: https://git.internal/runbooks/gpu-surge/PR-99 1 includes checklist and rollback steps. Please review.

marta: Billing note: ops-bot estimate for a 48h +32 GPUs bump ~ $4.8k. Billing to confirm.

zhen: I'll add unit tests for the replay harness and a quick script `scripts/run_surge_replay.sh`.

jordan: For canary, I'll run A/B on `gpu-canary-a` vs `gpu-canary-b` and capture delta. Also will add a short-term scaling cooldown to prevent oscillation.

ravi: Two process items: 1) weekly 15-min check-ins for 4 weeks to watch for recurrence (owner: all) 2) add a recurring postmortem summary to the incident doc linking INFRA tickets.

ops-bot: Recurring calendar "GPU follow-ups: postmortem" created Wednesdays 09:30 UTC for next 4 weeks. Invite: https://calendar.internal/e/9988.

marta: Final ETAs: quota Fri 18:00 UTC.

jordan: Scheduler canary Tue COB.

zhen: Telemetry + harness Thu EOD.

tess: Runbook Wed AM.

ravi: Autoscaler guardrail Mon EOD.

ravi: Thanks team. We'll treat this thread as canonical action register until tickets close. If any blocker surfaces, call it out here and we'll escalate to oncall. :white_check_mark:\"
